Julia Cameron has been an active artist for four decades.
She is the author of more than forty books, fiction and nonfiction, including such bestselling works on the creative process as The Artist’s Way, Walking in this World, and Finding Water.
A novelist, playwright, songwriter, and poet, she has multiple credits in theater, film, and television.
She divides her time between Manhattan and the high desert of New Mexico.
